# Harbour Lane Books: shop policies

This is a sample: the policies of a made-up shop, to show what this document looks like. Replace it with your own.

## Shipping

- Orders ship within 2 business days from our shop in Bristol.
- UK standard delivery costs £3.50 and takes 2 to 4 business days. It is free on orders over £30.
- We email a tracking link as soon as an order ships.

## Returns

- You can return a book in the condition it arrived within 30 days of delivery, for any reason.
- Reply to your order confirmation and we send a prepaid return label.
- We refund the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the book.
- Signed copies and gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned.

## Damaged or wrong items

- Tell us within 14 days of delivery, with a photo of the book and its packaging.
- We send a replacement or a full refund, including delivery, whichever you prefer.
